intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Strong by design, made for comfort
features.text: Crafted from high-quality engineered wood, our bed offers dependable support and timeless design — created to feel like home from day one.

features.title: A headboard that grounds your space
features.text: Wide, structured, and quietly confident — our headboard gives your bedroom an anchor, while offering comfort for reading or relaxing.

features.title: Hydraulic storage made beautifully easy
features.text: Just lift and store — our smooth hydraulic system gives you instant access to a generous hidden compartment, without the strain. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: A soft, modern touch for your space
features.text: Our Sonoma oak laminate finish brings a gentle, natural vibe to your room — creating a peaceful backdrop for everyday living.

features.title: Protected against everyday wear
features.text: With a durable PU coating, your bed stays looking fresh and well-kept, resisting scratches and daily wear with ease.

name: Upmods Eudora King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
